mentions.name: Crewbird
mentions.description: This field service management platform and CRM for service-based businesses integrates with Google Local Service Ads and tracks every dollar of ad spend to determine return on ad spend; the builder's father's carpet cleaning company is approaching 3x ROAS with it.
mentions.problem: The Google LSA dashboard left a lot to be desired for tracking ad spend return, existing SaaS CRMs lacked good Google Ads API integrations, and the business's old Windows desktop CRM was discontinued and one OS update away from no longer working.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built Crewbird, a Field Service Management and CRM for service based businesses with Google LSA integration where my dad is quickly approaching 3x ROAS!

evidence.value: So I built Crewbird, a Field Service Management and CRM for service based businesses with Google LSA integration where my dad is quickly approaching 3x ROAS!
